newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank only climber on Beirut bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bank only climber on Beirut bourse.

text.p: Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce was the only winner on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday and both Solidere shares dropped.
The LIBX bank index fell 0.67 percent to 190.04 and the LISPI fell 0.97 percent to 96.26 while the BLOM dropped 1.78 percent to 1091.33
BSE turnover fell to 181,154 from 192,037 for a value of $2,092,210 against $2,488,136.
Solidere A and B fell from $13 each to $12.6250 and $12.8750 respectively.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce climbed to $20.75 from $20.25 and Banque Audi was steady at $27.25. Bank of Beirut fell to $5.50 from $5.75.
Ciments Libanais was steady at $1.2813. Eternit fell to $1.90625 from $2.
There was no trade in the other listed industrial firms -- Uniceramic and Ciments Blancs.
